title: Päijät-Häme: 0.5 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €41,000 a year
markdown:
# Päijät-Häme: 0.5 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €41,000 a year

> 0.5 more patients a year treated to cure · €41,000 of €1M · €959,000 left: nothing more pays off on today's evidence

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in Päijät-Häme, 30 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. The difference is within what chance alone gives a county of this size. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties (30.4%), about 1.0 patient a year is missing from treatment that aims to cure, with a range of 0.0 to 5.6. [^care_curative] [^model] Against Finland as a whole, there is no shortfall to divide between fewer operated and fewer given radiotherapy that aims to cure. [^model]

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 29.6% to 30.0% by 2028: 0.5 more patients a year (range 0.0–0.5), for €41,000 a year, about €82,000 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **Needs the collaborative area (university hospital)** | | | | |
| 1 | **A chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate**[^ev_surgeon_second_opinion_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; chief of thoracic surgery at the university hospital | €41,000 | 0.5 (0.0–0.5) | Agree with the university hospital that a thoracic surgeon joins the weekly lung meeting, and send last quarter's stage I-II patients who were not operated for a second look. | Share of patients operated: 11.8% → 12.2% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€41,000** | **0.5 (0.0–0.5)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €633,566 a year; modelled to avoid 1.1 deaths a year (0.2–2.8). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 29.6% (2019–2023, measured) → 30.0% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- Share of patients operated: 11.8% → 12.2% by 2028. [^care_surgery][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

The remaining €959,000 buys nothing more toward treatment to cure. The access measures are limited by the reachable part of the measured shortfall, not by money. [^model] To see what else the money could do, look at low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or rank measures by deaths avoided instead. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 104 deaths a year in Päijät-Häme, and this plan is modelled to avoid 0.1 of them a year. [^deaths] [^model]

## Pilot ask

A six-month pilot of two actions: a chest surgeon reviews every decision not to operate, and every patient who cannot be operated is referred for precise radiotherapy. In six months that is about 66 new patients and 58 decisions reviewed. If our assumptions hold, about 0 of them (0 to 0) move to treatment that aims to cure in that time, and the share rises from 29.6% to 30.0% by 2028. The pilot replaces those assumptions with a count. [^model]

## Limits

- Effects are ranges, not probabilities. They show the lowest and highest results when all assumed effect sizes move together, and no trial has measured them. [^model]
- The comparison with the expected share is adjusted only for residents' age, not for stage, other illness, histology, how cancer was found, smoking or recording. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- The estimated symptom-to-treatment clock is not used here. In a county-level check, none of 3 measured outcomes matched it beyond chance. [^model]

pilot.text_fi: Kuuden kuukauden pilotti kahdesta toimesta: rintakirurgi arvioi jokaisen päätöksen jättää leikkaamatta, ja jokainen potilas, jota ei voida leikata, lähetetään stereotaktiseen sädehoitoon. Kuudessa kuukaudessa se tarkoittaa noin 66 uutta potilasta ja 58 arvioitua päätöstä. Jos oletuksemme pitävät, noin 0 heistä (0–0) siirtyy sinä aikana parantavaan hoitoon, ja osuus nousee 29,6 %:sta 30,0 %:iin vuoteen 2028 mennessä. Pilotti korvaa oletukset lasketuilla luvuilla.
pilot.cannot_show_en: Six months is too short to show the county's share moving. It is long enough to count reviews done, decisions changed and referrals made, against the same six months a year earlier.
pilot.cannot_show_fi: Kuusi kuukautta on liian lyhyt aika osoittamaan alueen osuuden muutosta. Se riittää laskemaan tehdyt arviot, muuttuneet päätökset ja lähetteet ja vertaamaan niitä samaan jaksoon vuotta aiemmin.
